stages.journal: I woke in the hold of a work barge with no memory of how I came aboard. A man with a roll waits outside the hold's door. I'm to speak to him.
The man with the roll says my name is not on it and I owe nobody here. If I want work, I'm to find Sample-Contact at the Sample House in Lilmoth.
I found Sample-Contact at the Sample House in Lilmoth. I'm to ask her to take me in.
Sample-Contact took me in. I serve the Reed now.
Sample-Contact is dead. Nobody else in Lilmoth will take me in.

objectives.text: Speak to the man at the hold's door.
Ask Sample-Contact to take you in.

lines.speaker: npc.example.roll-man
lines.text: Your name is not on my roll. You owe nobody here, so get off my pier. Want work? Find Sample-Contact at the Sample House in Lilmoth.

lines.speaker: npc.example.roll-man
lines.text: Your name is not on my roll. You owe nobody here, so get off my pier. Want work? Find Sample-Contact at the Sample House in Lilmoth.

lines.speaker: npc.example.contact
lines.prompt: I was told you have work.
lines.text: Work for those who ask the right way.

lines.speaker: npc.example.contact
lines.text: She asks whether the player will serve the Reed.

lines.speaker: npc.example.contact
lines.text: She tells the player to come back when they are sure.

lines.speaker: npc.example.contact
lines.text: She greets the player as one of the Reed.

take: Short and linear: wake on a barge, talk to the Gang Boss, go to Sample-Contact, join the Reed. Travel was automatic and the quest was easy to follow. But the dialogue was placeholder text ("[not yet written; the gist:]"), so I never learned who the Reed is, why I was on the barge, or who I am. Joining something I know nothing about felt hollow. I would want to know what happens next, but only if the story were actually written.
answers: 1. Presumably take orders from Sample-Contact and learn what the Reed wants, but the game gave no new objective. 2. The Reed, whatever that is. I agreed because I had no other lead and the Gang Boss sent me away. 3. The placeholder dialogue, "[not yet written; the gist:]". Also, I do not know why I woke on the barge. 4. Write the real lines. Tell me what the Reed is and what I would be doing, and give the player a reason to join, not just a button to press.
